thread:
pm_rohan: quick sync — we need to finalize request/response fields for the embeddings+rerank work. customers A + B gave constraints: A needs per-item traceability for rerank signals; B demanded minimal token overhead on every request. can we pick a compact schema that satisfies both?
anya: +1. main tradeoff is telemetry vs token overhead. if we include full prompt text for trace it's costly. propose keeping prompt hashes + per-call token counts. :thinking_face:
jlee: agree. suggestion: keep these fields: request_id, trace_id, model, model_version, token_budget (opt), usage.{input,output,total} but usage.* is a bit verbose. maybe `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `tokens_total` which are 3 small ints.
marcus: +1 to tokens_in/out naming — shorter on wire. for rerank we also need per-candidate signals: keep `candidates: [{id, score, reason_code?}]` but customers want opaque ids so we should make `candidate_id` stable across calls.
pm_rohan: concrete launch constraints: must land docs, SDK mappings (py/ts), and a migration doc for existing customers. SLO: response overhead < 120 bytes median for simple embedding calls.
anya: on `trace_id` vs `request_id` — we should reserve `trace_id` for distributed tracing (span cohesion) and `request_id` as root for the API call. include both: `request_id` visible to customers, `trace_id` for internal debugging. we can expose trace_id when customer opts in.
ops-sam: infra-bot warns: deploy limits for logging increases if we start shipping full prompt text. recommend opt-in `include_prompt` boolean and default false. infra-bot: :warning: retention and quota impacts flagged.
infra-bot: [system] Logging policy check: flagged fields -> prompt_text, full_candidates. Please add opt-in gating for PII controls.
jlee: ok so final minimal response payload for embeddings call (compact) proposal:
```json
{
  "request_id": "r_abc123",
  "model": "openembedding-xlarge-v1",
  "model_version": "1.2.0",
  "tokens_in": 12,
  "tokens_out": 0,
  "tokens_total": 12,
  "trace_id": "t-xyz987",
  "embedding": [0.001, -0.12, ...],
  "meta": {"region":"us-west-2"}  // small free-form map
}
```
marcus: for rerank response include `candidates` array but minimize per-item payload:
```json
"candidates": [
  {"candidate_id":"c_44","score":0.87},
  {"candidate_id":"c_17","score":0.03}
]
```
pm_rohan: need to decide on `meta` vs top-level `region` etc — prefer single `meta` object to avoid schema churn. make it allowed-but-ignored fields by runtime.
anya: structured output / tool calling: we should standardize `tools_called: [{name, ok, output_snippet?}]` and `structured` field with `format` & `payload` (both strings) so SDKs can parse. default `structured`: null.
ops-sam: regarding token budget enforcement: if `token_budget` provided, server should return `budget_exhausted: true|false` and `budget_remaining` in ints. small ints keep wire small.
jlee: one more: telemetry naming convention: use snake_case for JSON fields to be consistent with current API (we know some customers prefer camelCase, but SDKs will map).
pm_rohan: launch plan: 1) PR with spec + example payloads (this week), 2) SDK patch to map names (next week), 3) canary with opt-in customers (2 wks), 4) GA. OK if we add `include_prompt` opt-in in canary only?
anya: yes canary only for prompt. Also add a test to measure median payload size for embedding calls. goal <120 bytes.
marcus: for migration: provide a short migrate guide script that maps `tokens_{in,out,total}` to previous `usage` object for older SDKs.
ops-sam: security: add audit flag `expose_trace: boolean` on org settings — default false.
pm_rohan: action items: @jlee draft spec PR with the compact payload + rerank candidate shape. @anya add compliance/opt-in note. @marcus write migration snippet. @ops-sam confirm audit gating. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up if PR lands today. :thumbsup:
jlee: on it, will include sample payloads and size estimates in PR.
anya: adding small note — include `schema_version` top-level string so we can evolve without breaking.
pm_rohan: perfect. closing this thread, will ping when PR is up. :rocket:
